text:
claire: quick 8min sync  plan small-batch newsletter + nurture for the 'Accelerator' benchmark release + webinar. KPIs: RSVP rate, bench downloads, demo requests.
omar: propose 4-email cadence for warm lists, 3-email for cold. Warm: announce -> invite -> case study -> last-chance. Cold: announce -> invite -> nudge.
rachel: segmentation: Warm (trial active last 30d), Product PMs, Content subs (cold). exclude unsub, gdpr_do_not_contact, enterprise_do_not_contact. add suppression for anyone who registered in last 180d.
aj: deliverability notes: sending from SendGrid pool "accelerator-1". confirm IP warmness and set throttles: warm 1200/min, product PMs 700/min, cold 450/min. prefix suppression to dedupe.
ian: creative ops: hero variants - screenshot vs savings chart. outputs: 1200x628, 600x300, plus a small GIF for social proof. will drop into /marketing/assets/accelerator by Tue noon.
rachel: subject candidates: 
- "Accelerator benchmark: real per-token economics"
- "Cut inference spend, keep latency fast"
- "Live demo + benchmark walkthrough (RSVP)"
preheaders: "Join our live Q&A" / "Bench + actionable tips"
claire: A/B plan: test subject A vs B for warm; for product PMs test subject + first-line personalization. use 50/50 sample splits where applicable.
omar: CTA flow: primary CTA -> Register. After reg: auto send bench download + calendar invite. post-webinar: follow-up with download + demo CTA. track demo clicks to create lead in CRM.
aj: tracking tags: utm_campaign=accel_launch_q2, utm_content=warmA/B/pm. events: email_sent, email_open, webinar_registered, bench_downloaded, demo_clicked. include campaign tags in event payload.
ian: assets: will include ALT text and mobile-safe crops. also include plain-text copy variant for enterprise sends.
rachel: send windows: Warm Tue 9am PT, PM Wed 10am PT, Cold Thu 11am PT. stagger send times to avoid ESP spikes.
sendgrid-bot: ESP status: pool "accelerator-1" warmness 79%, projected steady in 30h.
aj: infra: retry on 5xx with exponential backoff, max retries 6. cap daily sends per recipient = 2 for this campaign. also ensure link shortener preserves UTM params for CRM ingestion.
omar: deliverability checklist: remove known role accounts, suppress recent webinar registrants, check DKIM/SPF alignment, seed list for QA.
claire: QA: internal seeds to claire, omar, rachel, aj, nian + 7 external test accounts. check images, alt text, calendar ics, unsubscribe link.
rachel: copy draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/mkt/accelerator/email-drafts (please comment). need approvals by Mon 4pm PT to schedule Tue send.
aj: I'll run audience QA Mon AM. nian: will upload final assets Mon 11am.
omar: small copy tweak: use "per-token cost" in technical lines; keep conversational tone for general audience.
claire: any blockers?
ian: waiting on final audience export from Data by Fri EOD.
rachel: legal review required for enterprise variant, cc legal@redwood.ai.
aj: none from infra.
sendgrid-bot: automation check: calendar invite + 24h reminder mapped, fallback to download page if demo slots full.
claire: great. reconvene Mon after approvals. thanks everyone :sparkles:
